title: Hidden Volcanic World Found Deep Beneath the Ocean
script: Scientists recently mapped a hidden volcanic world miles beneath the ocean surface, and it is actively rewriting marine biology textbooks. Using advanced sonar, researchers uncovered an underwater mountain range taller than the Empire State Building, entirely covered in hydrothermal vent fields. Instead of a barren wasteland, this abyss teems with life. They discovered towering glass sponge reefs and ghostly white crabs thriving in pitch blackness under extreme pressure. Most surprisingly, these organisms do not rely on sunlight for energy. Through chemosynthesis, they feed on toxic minerals erupting directly from the Earth's crust. This discovery proves that vibrant ecosystems can exist completely cut off from our sun, opening thrilling new possibilities for finding alien life in the dark oceans of distant moons.
